candidate_reports.remark: Water is flowing across several county roads near the Vermilion Regional Airport (KDNV). A vehicle is stranded in high water as well.
Numerous in-town roads flooded in Bismarck.
Multiple areas flooded on Bowman between North Danville and Bismarck.
South Collett Street around Stoney Creek is having several calls for rescues from flooded houses. Danville Fire_ Police and Sheriff Dept on scene with ladder trucks and boats. Numerous roads blocked
Public rain report relayed from broadcast media.
Junction Street closed from flood waters with a SUV stuck with water up to the headlights.
SWOP observer report of 3.65 inches of rain since yesterday evening.
NWS Employee reported 1.44 inches of rain from 0745am to 0900 am.
ASOS station KPIA Peoria Intl Arpt.
SWOP report. Storm total that includes morning storms.
24 hour rainfall report from SWOP observer.
24 hour rainfall total from COOP observer.
Rainfall report of rain that has fallen since 1000AM. Public report relayed by broadcast media. Rain still falling at time of report.
Rainfall report since estimate 1015am. More rain expected.
South IL-32 has water across the road and DOT has been requested to put signage out for the road.
IL-32 has water across the road and DOT has been requested to put signage out for the road.
Rainfall total since 12:20PM - more rain falling at time of report.
Rainfall report in the last 1 hr and 40 mins. Rain continues to fall at the time of the report.
6th Ave and Charleston Ave being heavily flooded.
Lakeland Blvd has water across the roads and is impassable. Water is coming up out of the manhole covers and out of the drainage system.
Marshall Ave has water across the roads and is impassable. Water is coming up out of the manhole covers and out of the drainage system.
Image of water halfway up the tires of a sedan driving down 5th Street and Charleston Ave.
Video of water across the roads and reaching over the curbs onto the sidewalks.
Several yards and the road has become a small pond from the heavy rain.
Video of a residential area with the water covering the roads going over the curbs.
Dispatch reported W Carl Sandburg Drive has been closed due to flood waters. Several other roads in Galesburg are experiencing minor flooding as well.
Tuscola has received 2 inches of rain since 1245PM with rain continuing to fall at time of report.
Intersection of south 10th St and Vine Street the roads are inundated with standing water.
Parking lots_ driveways_ and roads are completely inundated with approximately 1 foot of standing water.
Parking lots and roads are inundated with standing water.
Highway 130 has standing water across the roadway in Greenup.
ASOS station KMTO Coles Co. Mem AP.
Several roads inundated with standing water.
Social media photo reveals feet-deep water across lawns_ seeping into the basements of several homes in Dieterich.
CO-OP Observer station CRSI2 0.8 SE Charleston.
Water running across IL 123 during heavy rain.
Photo relayed via social media of approximately 5 inches in a rain gauge_ with flooding of adjacent field in the background.
Social media photo shows standing water over a roadway under an overpass on Cook St.
AWOS station KIJX Jacksonville Arpt. 6 hour total. 1.25 inches fell in one hour from 455 to 555pm.
Mesonet station SRCI2 3.6 E Tower Hill.
ASOS station KMTO Coles Co. Mem AP.
24 hour rainfall report from SWOP observer.
Water over Illinois 95 at Smithfield relayed by emergency management.
CO-OP Observer station HOPI2 0.8 W Hoopeston.
[Delayed Report] - Several trees blown down and corn damaged by thunderstorm winds. Time estimated by radar.
[Delayed Report] - Water running over roads_ measured 1 inch of rainfall in 23 minutes.
AWOS station KPRG Edgar Co. Arpt.
